what: observe (Andrew 2026-11-01 03:31, item 5). At each build request end, where job.rs makes its BuildRow (`row()`, line ~938), call `db.storage().take_counts(|kind, executed, verified, reran| blaze_profile::query_counts(blaze_profile::QueryCounts { build: request.0, kind, executed, verified, reran }))` once take_counts lands (queued to db). Also FYI: I added `tree: None, blaze: None` to the BuildRow literal in job.rs row(): blaze-profile History::build_ended now fills builds.tree (blaze-v2-proof tree digest of the workspace) and builds.blaze (blaze executable hash) on the history thread.
